paragraphs.jp: ケンさんは{毎日|まいにち}コンビニのお{弁当|べんとう}を{食|た}べています。ユイさんが「カレーは{簡単|かんたん}だよ。{作|つく}ってみて」と{言|い}いました。ケンさんはスーパーで{肉|にく}と{野菜|やさい}とカレーのルーを{買|か}いました。
paragraphs.en: Ken eats convenience store lunches every day. Yui said, “Curry is easy. Try making some.” Ken bought meat, vegetables, and curry roux at the supermarket.

paragraphs.en: The box said, “700 millilitres of water.” But Ken had no measuring cup at home. “Probably about this much.” Ken poured lots of water into a big pot.

paragraphs.en: An hour later, the curry was done. But it looked like soup. The meat and vegetables were swimming in brown water. While Ken was wondering what to do, the doorbell rang. It was Yui and Mrs. Tanaka. “Something smells good!”

paragraphs.en: The three of them ate together. Mrs. Tanaka said, “This is soup curry! It’s a famous dish from Hokkaido.” Yui also said, “It’s delicious!” Ken was a little embarrassed, but very happy.

{肉|にく}を{入|い}れなかったから
{田中|たなか}さんが{水|みず}を{入|い}れたから

スープカレー
{甘|あま}いカレー

paragraphs.jp: {六月|ろくがつ}になりました。ケンさんの{髪|かみ}は{長|なが}くなりました。それで、{近|ちか}くの{床屋|とこや}へ{行|い}きました。{店|みせ}のおじさんは{英語|えいご}が{話|はな}せません。ケンさんも{難|むずか}しい{日本語|にほんご}はわかりません。
paragraphs.en: It was June. Ken’s hair had grown long. So he went to the barber nearby. The man at the shop can’t speak English. Ken doesn’t understand difficult Japanese either.

paragraphs.en: The chair was very comfortable. Ken fell asleep again. When he woke up, there was a stranger in the mirror. His hair was very short. He looked like a baseball player.

paragraphs.en: The next day at school, Mr. Yamamoto said, “Huh? Are you a new student?” The whole class laughed. In the evening, Yui said, “It suits you! It’ll be cool in summer.” Ken touched his head and smiled a little.

{髪|かみ}の{色|いろ}を{変|か}えたかった
{髪|かみ}を{洗|あら}うだけでよかった
{少|すこ}しだけ{切|き}りたかった

paragraphs.en: Three days later, Ken was well again. He went to Mrs. Tanaka’s home to say thank you. But when Mrs. Tanaka opened the door, she was wearing a mask and coughing. Ken said, “This time, I’ll make the porridge!”

questions.q: {田中|たなか}さんはどうしてケンさんの{部屋|へや}に{来|き}ましたか。

ケンさんの{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえなかったから

{学校|がっこう}の{先生|せんせい}に{聞|き}いたから

{山本|やまもと}{先生|せんせい}
{田中|たなか}さん
ケンさんのお{母|かあ}さん
